scope: Proposition 2.5 (Simultaneous response) of the manuscript “A polynomial-time construction of strong thin trees” (preprints/A-polynomial-time-construction-of-strong-thin-trees-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 174 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 da0e75ba53ff393f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let H be connected and let G ⊆ H be a spanning subgraph. Let r be a sufficiently large integer, put h = ⌊r/2⌋, and suppose G and the subgraphs induced by all parts of a nested sequence of partitions are h-edge-connected, with the singleton condition vacuous. If 0 < s ≤ r1/4, there is Y ∈ KH such that, at every partition P in the sequence, all but at most r−1/3|EG(P)| crossing edges satisfy Y ⪰ 6s bebT e . (2.16) Here EG(P) denotes the edges whose endpoints lie in different parts of P.
